text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One conquered the Arima Kinen, 
finally standing at the "top" of both the 
regional and central circuits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the center of the greatest 
festival of all, Inari One whips Nakayama 
into a frenzy by declaring that every race 
and every Umamusume—regional or central—is 
equally the best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Inari One was named Umamusume of 
the Year. A festive celebration organized 
by the people of Oi began with great, 
boisterous energy.
